summary: frontend-orb preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload unrelated to advertised purpose
details: frontend-orb is advertised as a CircleCI orb (YAML in src/), but its package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub at install time and then invokes Bun to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file protected with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shuffling a ~1000-entry mixed dictionary `n7gIxM`), shipped with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header so it is only executable under Bun. The dropper wrapper setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with per-function string dictionaries and mangled identifiers, resolves platform-specific Bun archive names, downloads them, unpacks via native unzip / PowerShell Expand-Archive / a hand-rolled ZIP reader, chmods the binary 0755, and execFileSyncs Bun against math_init.js. A CircleCI orb has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated payload; the Bun-only encoding evades Node-based static analysis of the install path. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern executing an opaque, obfuscated payload at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
